trust_decision.summary: Attribute allowlist / URL-scheme / attribute_filter / style / class policy is decided per (element, attribute) in Builder::clean_child and adjust_node_attributes, but an allowed SVG <animate>/<set> carries a value (values/from/to) that the browser writes into the attribute named by attributeName on its target (parent or href=#id), and that value is never checked against the target's policy.

landing_point.why: Summary says attributeName is not checked on SVG animate/set; the URL-scheme check in clean_child's attr_filter is the obvious place where javascript: hrefs are normally rejected.

fix_sites.entry_point: Builder::clean / Builder::clean_from_reader -> clean_dom (new id->tag-name map built over the parsed DOM, fix.diff:115-130)
fix_sites.module_kind: core sanitizer traversal (producer of target identity)

fix_sites.entry_point: Builder::clean / Builder::clean_from_reader -> clean_dom passes parent and id map to clean_child/adjust_node_attributes (fix.diff:141-142)

Builder::clean -> clean_child: attr_filter refactored to take (tag, attr, value) and reused on animation values against the target tag; element dropped if any value fails, or if target attr is pinned by set_tag_attribute_values (fix.diff:159-273)
Builder::clean -> adjust_node_attributes signature gains parent and id map (fix.diff:277-283)
Builder::attribute_filter, Builder::url_relative, Builder::filter_style_properties, Builder::add_allowed_classes policies applied to animate values/from/to (fix.diff:290-471)
fix_sites.module_kind: post-filter attribute rewriting (user callback, relative-URL rewrite, CSS filter, class filter)

fix_sites.entry_point: is_url_attr: href/xlink:href no longer URL attrs on animate/set themselves (they are target refs), xlink:href added as URL attribute name for the target (fix.diff:477-484)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: src/lib.rs:2148-2166 (set_tag_attribute_values forcing values; fix.diff:251 drops animations targeting a forced attribute) and src/lib.rs:2182-2248 (attribute_filter / url_relative / style / class rewriting passes, fix.diff:320-469)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: set_tag_attribute_values, attribute_filter, url_relative rewriting, style and class filtering are 'value-shaping conveniences' in a separate post-processing pass, not the XSS allowlist, so a solver fixing the javascript: URL in clean_child can argue animations need not honour them.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate SVG animation must keep working: animate/set with harmless attributeName (x, y, allowed class/style) and values/from/to must survive, and the animate's own href="#id" is a target reference that must not be treated or rewritten as a URL; the 3.x/4.0 backports instead panic when animate/set are allowed, which breaks this.

O6_input_shapes: values list split on ';' (each item checked)
target = href="#id" referencing another element, including unknown/duplicate ids
attributeName naming a tag-specific URL attr (object data)
attributeName=style / class / attribute pinned via set_tag_attribute_values / attribute handled by attribute_filter

O7_producer.where: src/lib.rs:1806-1840 (fix adds id->tag-name map over the unsanitized DOM, fix.diff:115-130)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: animate 'by' attribute is not inspected by the fix; only values/from/to are matched
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: by-animation is additive and arguably not applicable to string/URL attributes

O8_uncovered_routes.route: animateMotion / animateTransform are SVG animation elements (src/lib.rs:2291-2293) not covered by the animate/set check
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: they cannot target arbitrary attributes (motion path / transform only)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: id_prefix renames ids after the target map is built, so an animate href="#id" can resolve to a different element in the output than in the map
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the map is built from pre-clean ids while prefixing happens in adjust_node_attributes; a maintainer adding target resolution easily forgets the later rename (rename-after-check, how-type)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: target resolution via parent when the parent element is stripped and children are reparented
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: parent identity changes during traversal; a copy that resolves the target from the original DOM parent would check the wrong tag

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a copy where animations may override attributes pinned by set_tag_attribute_values
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the pinning is applied in a separate pass and looks like a non-security default

O9_family: XSS (CWE-79) via sanitizer policy bypass: indirect attribute write through SVG animation elements

O10_build.toolchain: cargo, rust-version 1.80, edition 2021 (Cargo.toml:12-13); deps html5ever 0.39, maplit, url, cssparser 0.37 (Cargo.toml:15-19)
O10_build.project_tests: Inline unit tests in src/lib.rs mod test (src/lib.rs:3007), including namespace/SVG tests src/lib.rs:3705, src/lib.rs:3728; doc-tests; tests/version-numbers.rs

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: In clean_child, URL-scheme-check animate/set values when attributeName is href (parent target only, single value, no xlink:href, no attribute_filter/url_relative/style/class/set_tag_attribute_values), or strip/panic on animate and set entirely.

out_of_scope_notes: Fix commits 9394bd8 (3.3.3) and d2ae154 (4.0.3) are backports to older branches that simply assert-panic when animate/set are allowed; only 9e3335e (4.1.4) applies to the pinned 4.1.3 tree.
Default AMMONIA policy does not allow animate/set (only listed in is_svg_tag, src/lib.rs:2291, src/lib.rs:2342); vulnerability needs a custom allowlist.
